what: Raw-base probe: Qwen3.8-27B (4-bit, no adapter) vs GLM-4.5-Air (4-bit, no adapter) on the 2026-07-25 three-way protocol. Asks whether the newest base that fits and trains on 128 GB beats the incumbent base BEFORE any adapter is trained.
why: docs/research: the July base pivot showed the raw base is the dominant lever (|d-0.5| 0.358 -> 0.191 with no adapter). GLM-4.5-Air is deprecated upstream; Qwen3.8-27B (2026-08-14, Apache 2.0, AA index 52, EQ-Bench creative 1669) was the strongest writer in the fits-and-trains class. Decision brief: claude.ai artifact 6b6195c7-11a0-4af7-8e91-b39619d5eb41.

protocol.contexts: 160 paired real contexts (~/blind_ab_run/triples_current.json, same set as 2026-07-25)
protocol.prompt: byte-faithful 3621B product prompt (~/blind_ab_run/persona_prompt.txt, unchanged from July on purpose so the base is the only variable; it still names the old employer/city)
protocol.generation: temp 0.7, max_tokens 256, enable_thinking=false, no adapter; mlx_lm.server 0.31.3 on :8747 (venv ~/blind_ab_run/venv-glm); driver ~/blind_ab_run/probe-2026-09-03/raw_base_probe.sh
protocol.control: July's GLM-raw triples (generation is base-bound) RE-JUDGED today so both arms see the same judge on the same day
protocol.judge: gemini-3.5-flash synthetic panel (scripts/blind_ab/simulate_raters.py, 3 personas x 2 orders, 6 workers)
protocol.judge_drift_check: today's re-judge of the July GLM-raw triples reproduced July to 3 decimals (detect 0.309, |d-0.5| 0.191; voice 4.97 vs 4.94) — the delta below is a base effect

verdict: FAIL for Qwen3.8-27B as a base swap. Pass condition was lower |d-0.5| AND lol <= 2; it is worse on both (0.225 vs 0.191; 23 vs 2). Detect-rate delta alone (0.034) is ~0.65 SE and not significant, but the lol register collapse (23/160 vs 2/160, the exact tell the July record credits the GLM base with eliminating) is decisive and mechanistic. Qwen is terser than Seth (0.76 vs 0.97 length ratio) and lower on voice and humanness. Stay on GLM-4.5-Air; do not spend a training cycle on this base.
caveats: Synthetic proxy only (~69% agreement with humans); the human sheet is the gate. A candidate that FAILS the proxy is not worth a sheet; a candidate that passed would still need one.
Raw base only. An adapter could in principle suppress the lol tell on Qwen, but the July record shows adapters add ~0.04 on top of the base, and the base here starts behind.
Prompt is the July 3621B generic prompt, not the compact production head; identical for both arms.
Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (the other shortlisted candidate) was NOT probed: at ~70 GB it cannot sit beside the 56 GB production server in 128 GB, so it needs :8741 stopped for the window.
incident_during_run: Unrelated to the probe: at 04:31:28 the production mlx-server on :8741 died with a Metal 'Insufficient Memory' while scripts/nightly_eval.sh's fidelity step loaded its own in-process copy of GLM-4.5-Air beside it (wired 94.8 GB, swap ~41 GB); process lingered as a ?E zombie, daemon blocked ~6 min on a half-open socket (src/core/http.c CURLOPT_TIMEOUT 600 s), box rebooted ~07:10. Probe had loaded nothing (hold loop). Follow-up chips filed: fidelity step must not co-load; local-provider HTTP needs connect timeout + short cap.
